title: Elsa’s Pet
description: A tiny wish. A very big pet.
notice: A make-believe adventure with Anna and Sarah. Read and choose, or listen together.
script:
story 2
variable hen = false hidden
variable tub = false hidden
scene meadow
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Elsa happy right
camera wide cut
camera wide cut
show Elsa happy right
Elsa [happy]: I can make a pet!
choice pet
option cat "A cat!" -> cat
option hen "A hen!" -> hen ; hen = true
label cat
scene cat-big
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Elsa happy right
show Cat neutral center
camera wide cut
move Cat bounce
react Elsa excited
I: Pop! A big cat!
goto big
label hen
scene hen-big
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Elsa happy right
show Hen neutral center
camera wide cut
move Hen bounce
react Elsa excited
I: Pop! A big hen!
goto big
label big
show Sarah surprised right
Sarah [surprised]: So big! No bed will fit!
Anna [curious]: A box? A tub?
choice bed
option box "Get a box." -> box
option tub "Get a tub." -> tub ; tub = true
label box
if hen == true -> henbox else catbox
label henbox
scene hen-box
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Elsa happy right
show Hen happy center
camera wide cut
I: The hen fits in the box!
goto settle
label catbox
scene cat-box
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Elsa happy right
show Cat happy center
camera wide cut
I: The cat fits in the box!
goto settle
label tub
if hen == true -> hentub else cattub
label hentub
scene hen-tub
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Elsa happy right
show Hen curious center
camera wide cut
I: The hen fits in the tub!
goto settle
label cattub
scene cat-tub
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Elsa happy right
show Cat curious center
camera wide cut
I: The cat fits in the tub!
goto settle
label settle
show Elsa worried right
Elsa [worried]: My pet will not nap.
choice nap
option pat "Pat the pet." -> pat
option sing "Sing a song." -> sing
label pat
react Anna nod
Anna [happy]: Pat, pat. A soft pat.
goto sleepy
label sing
react Sarah laugh
show Sarah happy right
Sarah [happy]: La, la, la! A song for a pet.
goto sleepy
label sleepy
show Elsa relieved right
Elsa [relieved]: A big yawn. It can nap!
if tub == true -> tubend else boxend
label tubend
I: A tub is a bed. What a snug pet!
goto finish
label boxend
I: A box is a bed. What a snug pet!
goto finish
label finish
show Sarah happy right
Sarah [happy]: Shh! We can rest too.
end

Anna.name: Anna
Anna.provenance: Storybook adaptation for Chunky Reader; shared polished SVG builder, not a likeness.

Sarah.name: Sarah
Sarah.provenance: Storybook adaptation for Chunky Reader; shared polished SVG builder, not a likeness.

Elsa.name: Elsa
Elsa.provenance: Storybook adaptation for Chunky Reader; shared polished SVG builder, not a likeness.
